stem: Based on the photograph and your knowledge of U.S. history, why were these veterans marching to the Pentagon in 1967?

options.label: A
options.text: They were celebrating U.S. victories in the Vietnam War.

options.label: B
options.text: They were hoping for a communist victory in the Vietnam War.

options.label: C
options.text: They supported the growing opposition to U.S. government policies in the Vietnam War.

options.label: D
options.text: They supported the growing opposition to drug use by communist soldiers in the Vietnam War.
